name: agent-10-bicycle-understeer-v1
description: Steady-state bicycle with understeer gradient (K_us) plus optional first-order yaw and steering low-pass lags. Per-platform L_eff, K_us, d0, tau_yaw, tau_steer fit by least squares on data/sim/segments truth (v*delta = L*yaw + K_us*yaw*v^2 + v*d0). TESLA_MODEL_3 has no truth in the workshop set and falls back to passing through the supplied V0 yaw_rate_pred_rads. Trajectory (x_m, y_m, psi_rad) integrated from predicted yaw and measured v_mps with trapezoidal rule.
